# Limitations

Our claim is scoped to Gemma~3 270M, the PT+affine Gemma Scope~2 CLT
dictionary, occupation \(a\)/\(an\) prompts, and the interventions we ran.
We did not isolate a pure context concept \(A\), nor run dedicated latent
noun-identity probes beyond executed tokens and coarse set means.
Stage~XVIII tests one hint-contrast residual construction at MLP-in;
other dense sites remain possible. Scale and model-family generalization
are outside our local compute envelope. Affine skip means sparse
interventions need not exhaust MLP computation; the residual null reduces
but does not eliminate that concern for every patch.
